findings.claim: Direct sales close before physical ticket confirmation — The added cobrarVentaDirecta path creates the order directly as estado: 'cobrado' (lines 241-249), deducts inventory (251-261), appends the order, clears the cart, and records the event (263-267). The complete added path has no spooler/ticket acknowledgement or recoverable printing-failure state.

Partial RTDB products fail open as free, available inventory — The new store adapter converts an invalid or absent price to 0, converts nonnumeric or absent stock to 99, and always sets cantidadReservada to 0 (lines 28-30) before sending those values to the sales hook.

RTDB hydration and tenant changes cannot refresh operational inventory — MostradorPanaderiaContainer recomputes catalogoInicial whenever productosStore or categoriasStore changes and passes it at line 55, but the hook consumes catalogoInicial only in the useState initializer at lines 36-40. Consequently, later hydration remains invisible and a retained component can continue holding the preceding tenant's inventory, cart, orders, and ledger.

The new ledger and completed sales exist only in volatile React memory — The added ledger is a useState array and registrarEvento only calls setLedger (lines 47-67). The newly added sale path likewise stores orders and inventory changes only through React setters, so unmount, process termination, or a device crash loses the purported audit record and transaction state.

Order-transition recovery performs side effects inside a retryable updater — Inside the setPedidos functional updater, the changed code invokes setInventario for delivery/cancellation and registrarEvento at line 339. The newly added cancellation restoration and ledger append therefore run as side effects of an updater that React may replay, allowing duplicate stock restoration or duplicate audit events.

A failing error reporter defeats slot error isolation — componentDidCatch invokes this.props.onError directly at lines 52-56 without isolating exceptions. If the reporting/logger dependency throws, that exception escapes the boundary lifecycle and can replace the intended slot fallback with a wider component-tree failure.
